method: All 30 final PNGs opened through view_image and inspected by the preview agent. PNG bytes were never edited. Hash and IHDR checks tie these observations to the final reports. 2560 images may be scaled only by the inspection UI; originals remain 2560x1440.

restartProcessLifecycle.priorHarnessProcessCheck: Read-only Win32_Process check before independent Electron spawn

screenshots.name: 00-default-world-list
screenshots.note: Main account and built-in InitialWorld visible; world/editor columns intact.

screenshots.name: 00a-initial-world-default-chart
screenshots.note: Legacy graybox world and existing debug HUD visible; exit control present. Smoke scope is default chart load/exit only.

screenshots.name: 00b-global-editor-directory
screenshots.note: Global editor tree and return control intact; no gameplay overlay remains.

screenshots.name: 01-create-world-form
screenshots.note: World title and description fields, create/cancel and InitialWorld visible without overlap.

screenshots.name: 02-multiple-world-list
screenshots.note: InitialWorld, world A and world B cards and controls visible.

screenshots.name: 03-fork-not-open
screenshots.note: Not-open message visible; all three cards remain.

screenshots.name: 04-minimal-world-movement
screenshots.note: Ground, spawn pad and red protagonist visible; protagonist elevated and displaced. HUD now has dark background, bright text and border.

screenshots.name: 05-return-world-list
screenshots.note: Three cards visible after exit; no 3D/HUD remnants.

screenshots.name: 06-delete-confirmation
screenshots.note: World B confirmation and both confirmation/cancel controls visible. 1080-height viewport uses normal vertical scrolling; no horizontal clipping.

screenshots.name: 07-local-world-tombstoned
screenshots.note: Removed status visible; only InitialWorld and active A remain.

screenshots.name: 08-persisted-after-window-restart
screenshots.note: After BrowserWindow reopen main account still lists InitialWorld and A.

screenshots.name: 09-reenter-world-at-spawn
screenshots.note: Protagonist centered on spawn pad; dark HUD panel/text correct and exit control visible.

screenshots.name: 10-second-account-isolated
screenshots.note: Second account label visible and only its InitialWorld present.

screenshots.name: 11-original-account-preserved
screenshots.note: Main account restored with only InitialWorld and A.
